## Case format
```json
{ "case_id": "PUB-01", "today": "2026-08-15",
  "pos":        [ {"id": "POS-001", "reference": "INV-2026-361299", "amount_bdt": "640.00", "time": "2026-08-15T13:21:00"}, ... ],
  "settlement": [ {"id": "STL-001", "reference": "069080/2026/INV", "amount_bdt": "2885.60", "time": "2026-08-15T18:34:00"}, ... ] }
```
`today` is the business date of the POS report. Settlement times may run past midnight. Settlement
references come in one of three styles per case: digits only (`2026361299`), lower case with the
leading zeros dropped (`inv_2026_69080`), or suffixed (`069080/2026/INV`).
